answer: Seed every grading batch with hidden known-answer canary items. Like dye poured into karst rock that reveals the hidden channels below, these canaries expose graders who rubber-stamp: a sybil swarm voting in lockstep is a mirror of one operator and fails the same canaries together. Accounts whose canary accuracy falls under 90% lose grading weight and forfeit pending rewards, so a cheap fleet must do real, crystal-clear work on every item, erasing its cost advantage.
